market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuelan crude production reported ~1.02-1.10m bpd in March 2026 per OPEC/CEIC sources. To resolve YES needs >=1.2m bpd in any month per OPEC MOMR through end of 2026. Goldman forecasts flat 900k baseline; analysts say 1.2m possible if sanctions lifted. Trajectory is upward but currently below threshold.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sanction policy and Maduro political situation are pivotal.
